options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby). Must not be blank.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (measure count, each measure's name, and how many are at or above target).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for values and targets in names, the tooltip, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Shared chart option; validated but has no effect (a bullet chart has no toggleable series).

options.name: measures
options.description: Rows: { id, label, value: number | null, target?: number, ranges?: number[] }. Ids are unique and non-empty; null, NaN, and infinities are a missing value; target is finite; ranges are up to three strictly ascending finite upper ends (the first range starts at the axis minimum).

options.name: rangeLabels
options.description: Names of the qualitative ranges in the same order as ranges (up to three, for example ["Poor", "Satisfactory", "Good"]); read in each measure's name, tooltip, and table. Default "Range 1", "Range 2", "Range 3".

options.name: color
options.description: Palette slot of the measure bars.

options.name: valueAxis
options.type: BulletChartValueAxis ({ label?: string; min?: number; max?: number; tickCount?: number; includeZero?: boolean })
options.description: Fixed domain (max > min; marks are clamped to it) and approximate tick count (2-20). The automatic domain always includes zero and spans every value, target, and range end. label and includeZero are validated but not drawn or used.

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

options.name: legend
options.description: Shared chart configuration; a bullet chart never shows a legend (ranges are named in each row's label).

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback (Measure, Value, Target, Range): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (value, target, range).

options.name: patterns
options.description: Shared chart configuration; toggles the aui-chart--patterns host class. Bullet charts draw no textures (one measure color; ranges are neutral shades named in text).

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000), divided evenly between rows; the width follows the container.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the value axis, moves labels to the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: hiddenSeries
properties.description: Always empty (a bullet chart has no toggleable series).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same measure (by id).

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; re-renders but has no visible effect on a bullet chart. Emits no event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: BulletChartPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart
cssClasses.description: Host (shared chart chrome).

cssClasses.name: aui-bullet-chart
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--patterns
cssClasses.description: patterns option on (no textures are drawn by a bullet chart).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description / __toolbar
cssClasses.description: Title and description; the toolbar stays hidden.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__legend
cssClasses.description: Legend list; always hidden for a bullet chart.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__grid / __gridline / __zero-line / __axis / __axis--value / __axis--category / __tick-label
cssClasses.description: Value axis and the measure label column (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__series--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Palette slot class on the rows group (color option); sets --aui-chart-color from color-chart-<n>.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__mark / __mark--active / __mark--hover
cssClasses.description: Focusable measure bar and its states.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__bar
cssClasses.description: Measure bar paint (series color with a surface-colored separator; text-colored outline on hover and focus).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-rows / __tooltip-row / __tooltip-label / __tooltip-value / __swatch
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused bar carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty
cssClasses.description: Empty state text (No data).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__summary
cssClasses.description: Hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__data / __data--hidden / __table-toggle / __table-scroll / __table / __cell--numeric
cssClasses.description: Data table fallback.

cssClasses.name: aui-bullet-chart__rows / __row
cssClasses.description: All rows, and one group per measure.

cssClasses.name: aui-bullet-chart__ranges / __range / __range--1 / __range--2 / __range--3
cssClasses.description: Decorative (aria-hidden) qualitative range bands, darkest first.

cssClasses.name: aui-bullet-chart__measure
cssClasses.description: The focusable measure bar.

cssClasses.name: aui-bullet-chart__target
cssClasses.description: Target tick (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-bullet-chart__label
cssClasses.description: Measure label beside the row (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--legend-bottom / --legend-start / --legend-end
cssClasses.description: theme.legendPosition (top is the default layout).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--no-grid / --gradient / --animate / --entering
cssClasses.description: theme.gridLines: false, theme.gradient, theme.animation (entering: the render that animates).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__annotations / __annotation-line / __annotation-band / __annotation-label / __annotation--<tone>
cssClasses.description: Annotations (aria-hidden), drawn under the marks.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__gradient / __gradient-stop
cssClasses.description: Gradient fills (theme.gradient).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip--custom
cssClasses.description: Tooltip content comes from renderTooltip.
